INFORMATION

Privacy, clearly.

Information about this website and the current NexaTik desktop workflow.

This website

This site has no account-registration form, advertising scripts or analytics configured. It uses locally hosted interface images and styles. Hosting infrastructure may process routine connection data such as IP addresses and request logs.

Downloads on GitHub

Setup downloads open on GitHub. GitHub handles those download requests under its own privacy policy. This website does not ask for your GitHub password or a personal access token.

The desktop application

NexaTik saves selected videos, metadata, settings and history on your computer. It connects to selected content platforms to load metadata and download available media. Update checks contact the public NexaTik GitHub Releases endpoint.

Browser verification

Some profile scans open Chrome or Edge. In version 0.5.2, Instagram uses a dedicated local browser profile to reuse a session. If you log in, credentials belong on the platform's own browser page. Session access is used for the requested scan and subsequent metadata/download operations; browser and platform privacy policies also apply.

Scope

This describes the features configured in this release, not a guarantee about third-party platform or hosting behavior. Do not include passwords, session cookies or private account data in a support screenshot or report.
